verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a SaaS payments platform, so choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no region or residency selection. The closest items are data ownership and export (docs-34) and a webhook guide for platforms on private networks (docs-32), and neither lets a user choose where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
